mechanism: Indomethacin may reduce CoQ10 levels through inhibition of mevalonate pathway enzymes, similar to statin-induced depletion, potentially impairing mitochondrial function and antioxidant capacity.
action: Monitor patients on chronic indomethacin therapy for signs of muscle weakness or fatigue; consider CoQ10 supplementation (100-200 mg daily) if prolonged NSAID use is necessary.
